title: Floral
summary: FLO'RAL, adjective [Latin floralis, from flos, a flower, which see.] 1. Containing the flower, as a floral bud; immediately attending the flower, as a floral leaf. 2. Pertaining to Flora or to flowers

inlines.v: FLO'RAL, adjective [Latin floralis, from flos, a flower, which see.] 1. Containing the flower, as a floral bud; immediately attending the flower, as a floral leaf. 2. Pertaining to Flora or to flowers; as floral games; floral play.
